name: ffxiv-vtt
description: Foundry VTT module for recreating features from Final Fantasy XIV.

scripts.build: echo "No build step defined. Use plain ES module source."
scripts.package: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Remove-Item -Force ffxiv-vtt.zip -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Compress-Archive -Path module.json, package.json, README.md, scripts, styles -DestinationPath ffxiv-vtt.zip -Force"
scripts.version: node update-version.js && git add module.json scripts/module.js
scripts.postversion: git push origin main && git push --tags
